page.layout: One printed page (left, p. 34) of running text in one column, Greek and Latin dictionary entries, with a catchword at the lower right. At the far right edge, a narrow strip of cropped marginal notes belonging to the facing page, too faint to read.

main_text.p: {Ἀναχωρέω} ὦ feeedo, regredior. F.ἥσω. P.ἀνακεχώρηκα. A.1. ἀνεχώρησα, Matth.9.24.
Ἀναψύχω refrigero, recreo. F.ἀναψύξω. P.ἀνέψυχα. A.1. ἀνέψυξα, 2.Tim.1.16.
Ἀνδροπόδον ὁ τὸ hominis pes, mancipium. ex ἀνὴρ ἀνδρὸς ὁ vir, & ποὺς ὁ pes.
Ἀνδραποδιστὴς ὁ plagiarius, 1.Tim.1.10. à verbo ἀνδραποδίζω mancipio, in captivitatem abduco. F.ίσω. P.ἠνδραπόδικα. Prat.pass.ἠνδραπόδισμαι.
Ἀνδρίζομαι mascule me gero, 1.Cor.16.13. P. ἀνδρίσομαι. P.pass.ἠνδρίσμαι.
Ἀνδροφόνος ὁ ἡ homicida, 1.Tim.1.9. ex ἀνὴρ vir, & φόνος occido. in p.med. πέφονα, unde est φόνος ὁ cædes.
Ἀνέγκλητος ὁ ἡ proprie qui propter manifestum scelus aliquod in jus vocari nequit. inculpatus. ἐγκαλέω voco, ἐγκαλέω ὦ in jus voco, accuso, ex α priv. & ἔγκλητος accusatus, Tit.1.6.
Ἀνεκδιήγητος ὁ ἡ inenarrabilis, 2.Cor.9.15. διηγέομαι duco. διηγέομαι explico.
Ἀνεκλάλητος ὁ ἡ ineffabilis, 1.Pet.1.8. λαλέω ὦ loquor.
Ἀνεκλειπτος ὁ ἡ non ceffans, nunquam deficiens, perpetuus, Luc.12.33.
Ἀνεκτότερον tolerabilius Adj.g.n. comparativi gradus, à positivo ἀνεκτὸς ἡ ὀν tolerabilis, à verbo ἀνέχομαι tolero, Matth.10.15.

page.notes: The right-hand strip belongs to the facing printed page 35. It is cropped at the edge and too faint and fragmentary to transcribe reliably, so it is omitted. Greek readings and abbreviations in the entries are doubtful in places (accents, breathings, some verb forms), and the scan is slightly blurred around the ink smudge near "ex α priv." and the entry "Tit.1.6." Only the left page's main text is transcribed.
